notes: Batch of 15 IRS-list groups. Search budget used in full (2 of 2): High Flock Comics (no match) and Balanced Veterans (the search showed its domain, which was then fetched). Fetch budget: 28 used of 60. Five groups are unknown records because they have no usable web address and were not searched: Bethel Agape Ministries, Cross Cultural Connect, Folamis Oasis, and Developing Excellence (its batch domain does not resolve; DNS failed on every try). High Flock Comics was searched but not found. A later run should search the four unsearched groups first. Dead or moved domains: balancedveterans.com redirects to balancedveterans.org; developingexcellence.net does not resolve. Dropped as leads: the Commission of Inquiry for Cambodia (a Save Cambodia project, not a separate group) and the Macro United conference (a conference, not a group). Named without links, so not listed as leads: Catalyst Church, Christ Community Church, Fathership Foundation, Rooted In Love Ministries, and the United Cambodian Association of Minnesota (not Philadelphia). No 403s, bot checks or logins were met. No forms were submitted and no one was contacted. Owner decisions to review: (1) Balanced Veterans and Empowering Freedom do peer support or suicide-prevention work, and support_group is false on both; the support flow rule may apply. (2) Echo Collective: its partisan status and Philadelphia location are both unconfirmed. (3) Oaks of Hope International: Philadelphia comes only from the IRS list. (4) Save Cambodia's calendar gives a Philadelphia street address for some briefings; not recorded. (5) Springboard's mailing address is c/o an individual, so only its ZIP is noted. Verdict counts: publish 14 (9 with content, 5 unknown and held back), out_of_area 1.
